title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of the legendary Feb 1970 Fillmore run, highlighted by an epic Dark Star → The Other One marathon and superb Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is a straight stereo sound‑board mix that most listeners describe as album‑ready, with only a single comment about slight low‑frequency loss. Musically the show is repeatedly called one of the all‑time greats – the 60‑minute Dark Star flowing into The Other One, a soaring Lovelight and tight band interplay make it a must‑listen performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.7/5; the vast majority praise both the show and the soundboard recording, with only a few policy‑related low scores that do not reflect performance or audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo soundboard mix described as crystal clear and album‑ready; one reviewer noted a slight loss of low‑end compared to other copies, but overall clarity and balance are praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a seamless transition from the opening electric set into an extended Dark Star that morphs into The Other One, followed by a high‑energy Lovelight and a solid acoustic set; the pacing is described as thrilling and cohesive.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for leading the marathon Dark Star and delivering inventive guitar work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for driving the high‑energy The Other One with powerful rhythm guitar.
